objective: Fresh, offline, same-freeze evaluation of exactly one globally selected algorithm against original low-confidence and a separate symmetric_fast comparator on all four benchmarks.
candidate_selection_order: trajectory_early_sparse_context_repair if v19 passes its preregistered cross-task gate
trajectory_early_localized_evidence_conflict_repair if v18 passes its preregistered cross-task gate
trajectory_original_anchor_pareto if v20 passes its preregistered four-task rapid gate
no strict candidate run when every registered candidate is rejected
removed_fallback: v15 is not eligible because its fresh same-host GSM8K full result regressed from 915/1319 to 887/1319; a known rejected family must not consume a new strict four-task run

arms.fast_comparator: fresh symmetric_fast tau=0.004; comparator only and never a routing component

acceptance.candidate: no benchmark regression and strict aggregate correct-count gain across HumanEval-164, MATH-500, GSM8K-1319, and MBPP-500
acceptance.integrity: zero prompt/target/runtime-token/id/evaluator mismatches, clean residual masks and NFE, leakage-v2 pass, offline artifact and complete model-weight hashes unchanged
acceptance.failure: preserve all outputs, label algorithm and evaluator/infrastructure failures separately, and do not substitute another algorithm after seeing strict results
